name: economy-games
author: Lumi Developers
description: Blackjack, roulette, crime with jail, work/beg/fish/mine grinds, and a role-granting shop — all settled through the core Economy ledger.
short: Casino games, crime, grinds, and a shop for the core economy.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server jail sentences and shop inventories keyed by user ID, plus short-lived cooldowns and active game tables in Redis. Currency balances and the transaction ledger are owned by the core Economy module. Game rows are removed on GDPR erasure.
